title: Na Upakaarivi Neevu Yesayya – K Y Ratnam Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నా ఉపకారివి నీవు యేసయ్యా నా సహకారివి నా యేసయ్య
english: naa upakaarivi neevu yesayya naa sahakaarivi naa yesayya
intro: Na Upakaarivi Neevu Yesayya a christian Telugu worship song written & produced by Dr. Victor Rampogu, sung by Raji Lekhana and music composed by K Y Ratnam. This song was released on July 10, 2021 through KY Ratnam Ministry Youtube channel.
